about_the_game:
FROM Z3-R0 TO HERO

Z3-R0 was never meant to be a hero. Once just a scout robot for the Multiplicity Multiverse Management Co., his only task was to observe and report. But when his ship crash-lands on a dying planet riddled with unstable anomalies, Z3-R0 is forced into a role he never trained for.

Armed with the Multi-Beam-Tool and a strange ability to duplicate himself, Z3-R0 must rely on copies of his own form to wield weapons, fight endless swarms, and cleanse corrupted timelines. While duplications take the fight to the enemy, Z3-R0’s job is to keep them alive, heal broken realities, and gather the resources needed to survive.

With his loyal companion R0-B0 and a new-found genius engineer J3-NNY, Z3-R0 embarks on a desperate mission to cleanse the planet, rebuild a ship, and maybe… find a way home.

HEAL FRACTURED TIMELINES

Use the Multi-Beam-Tool to restore broken realities inside anomalies. Each healing attempt unleashes chaotic bullet-hell battles — survive, gather rare resources, and purify anomalies to free the planet from corruption.

EXPLORE A FRACTURED MULTIVERSE

Every anomaly is a unique battlefield: from lush forests to bizarre floating biomes, each with its own enemies, hazards, and treasures. Clear them to unlock new regions, tribes, and mysteries.

BUILD, UPGRADE, ESCAPE

  • Gather rare materials to upgrade weapons, duplications, and R0-B0’s support systems.

  • Work with J3-NNY to craft gadgets and slowly reconstruct a new spaceship.

  • Shape your playstyle each run with powerful weapon modules and upgrades.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Healer gameplay with a twist — Z3-R0 heals and supports while duplications fight for you.

  • Dynamic duplication combat — summon copies that inherit your unlocked weapons.

  • Bullet-hell roguelite action — survive relentless swarms inside unstable anomalies.

  • Resource-driven progression — collect materials to unlock upgrades, tech, and permanent powers.

name: Multiplicity Multiverse Management Co.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 360 or equivalent (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated sound card
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better (4GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated sound card

short_description: Multiplicity Multiverse Management Co. is a fast-paced, survival-like auto-shooter. Duplicate yourself, battle hordes of enemies inside unstable multiverse anomalies, gather resources to upgrade your weapons, unlock new tech, and find your way home.
supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*
*languages with full audio support
